details.report: Unable to complete a method-compliant review within the task’s one-batch constraint. The sole permitted sibling batch was run, but the Standards prompt improperly included Spec behavioral verification criteria; the compliance audit therefore rejected the aggregation because Standards/Spec isolation was not demonstrated. Repair would require a second sibling batch with those requirements confined to the Spec leg, while the supplied task explicitly forbids any second batch. No additional batch was dispatched. The fixed target and non-empty range were established, but the required canonical review method cannot now be satisfied in this invocation.
